WingFoil-Version: 0.3.1 (unknown)

Rent equipment by the hour

addEquipment accepts an optional hourlyPrice. A rental shorter than a day
that starts and ends on the hour is priced at hourlyPrice per hour; items
without one cannot be rented by the hour. Whole-day rentals still start and
end at midnight UTC, and availability stays day-based.
